theorems.statement: ∀ (P m l : ℕ) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid m) (U : Set (Euclid m)) (S F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P l), MeasurableSet F → F ⊆ S → (∀ K : Set (Euclid m), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IsCompact (S ∩ pL ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) l, |ξ x β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ γ : Covector (Euclid m) l, covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U l, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U l, Y ω = ∫ x in F, ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid m) l) (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL) ∂μ
